description: This file implements a React functional component called Playlists for managing music playlists within a user interface. It provides features such as listing, creating, editing, and deleting playlists via API calls, along with UI controls like dialogs and buttons.

methods.name: fetchPlaylists
methods.description: Loads all playlists from the backend API and updates the state.

methods.name: openDialog
methods.description: Sets the dialog state to open for creating or editing a playlist.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes the dialog by resetting the dialog state.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves a new playlist or updates an existing one via API call, then refreshes the playlist list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the selected playlist via API call and refreshes the playlist list.
